name: Adult swimming lessons
summary: How adult expats learn or relearn swimming in Singapore — private vs group lessons, ActiveSG lane realities, fear-of-water pathways, and humid-heat practice planning.
body:
Adult swim schools and ActiveSG coaches run beginner-to-stroke programmes. Many expats arrive as weak or non-swimmers despite living near pools. Private lessons accelerate anxious beginners; groups suit fitness stroke correction.

## Formats
- Private 1:1 confidence and breath work
- Small adult beginner groups
- Stroke correction for former childhood swimmers
- Open-water / triathlon add-ons later
- Ladies-only or quiet-lane options where offered

Lane crowding and thunderstorm closures reshape booking strategy.

## How to choose
Prefer coaches who teach breath and float confidence before distance goals. Ask whether pool entry is included. Confirm teacher-to-student ratios for adult groups. Bring goggles that fit — rental pairs often leak.

## Practical tip
Book morning slots before work heat peaks. Consistency beats marathon weekend catch-ups when anxiety is the blocker.
